Specification: This module is a small test specification that checks the parsing and meaning of binary, octal, and hexadecimal numeric literals in TLA+. It extends Naturals and contains a single unnamed ASSUME block asserting that several binary, octal, and hexadecimal notations all denote the decimal value 63. The file does not model a transition system or algorithm, has no variables or actions, and contains no temporal properties; its purpose is purely to validate numeric literal syntax across upper- and lower-case base prefixes and hexadecimal digits.
